title: Study Group 1 - Way of the Bodhisattva
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating bodhicitta, or the thought of awakening, as a means of recognizing and taking responsibility for one's actions and motivations. By acknowledging our own imperfections and limitations, we can begin to let go of self-centeredness and cultivate greater humility and self-awareness. This process involves setting intentions and making offerings, such as giving something away, in order to deepen our understanding of ourselves and the world around us.
